articles.content_html:
A Chinook helicopter was spotted flying east over Castleton, Rochdale, on July 21, 2026. The aircraft was seen in the skies during the late afternoon, drawing attention from local residents.

Witnesses reported the helicopter's distinctive twin rotor blades and large size as it passed overhead. The sighting has sparked curiosity among those in the area.

No official information has been released regarding the purpose of the flight. However, Chinook helicopters are often used for military operations and transport.

Residents may have experienced increased noise levels during the flight, which could have affected local activities.
